en.title: Repeated status checks keep only the newest requested scope
en.scenario: A LatestStatus worker is held inside its first simulated saved-status check. Lists record executed checks and applied results.
actions: Start scope one and wait until its check is running.
Submit 100 more checks with the same key; each is refused as a duplicate.
Queue scope two, then scope three; release the first check and drain worker/Qt delivery.
expected_outcomes: Only first and three execute; two never executes.
Only three is applied; the first result is discarded.
en.risk_protected: Repeated refreshes must not create redundant work or let an older context overwrite the newest status.
not_proven: These are simulated status checks, not 100 AI analyses or paid model calls.
No scientific quality, live provider behavior, whole-application responsiveness or database preservation is asserted.

zh-TW.title: 重複查詢狀態時，只套用最後要求的範圍
zh-TW.scenario: 讓 LatestStatus 的第一個模擬已存分析狀態查詢暫停，並記錄實際執行的工作及套用結果。
actions: 啟動範圍 one，等它確實開始執行。
對相同鍵值再送出 100 次查詢，每次都必須被拒絕為重複工作。
先排入 two，再排入 three；放行第一個工作，等待背景工作及 Qt 結果傳遞完成。
expected_outcomes: 實際只執行 first 與 three；two 不執行。
只套用 three 的結果，第一個工作的過期結果不套用。
zh-TW.risk_protected: 防止連續重新整理產生多餘工作，或讓舊範圍的狀態蓋過最新狀態。
not_proven: 這是模擬狀態查詢，不是執行 100 次 AI 分析或付費模型呼叫。
未證明科學品質、真實供應商行為、整個應用程式的流暢度或資料庫保存。

en.title: A failed status check shows a safe message and allows retry
en.scenario: A simulated check raises ValueError with the fixture text 'private question and token'; error signals and applied results are recorded.
actions: Run the failing check and drain delivery.
Run another check under the same key that returns recovered.
expected_outcomes: The only error is exactly 'Saved analysis could not be checked; please retry'; no result is applied after failure.
The retry applies exactly recovered.
en.risk_protected: Private exception text must not become the status error, and failure must not permanently block retry.
not_proven: The private text is synthetic; live provider errors, actual credentials and every application error surface are not exercised.
This retries a saved-status check, not a paid AI analysis.

zh-TW.title: 狀態查詢失敗時顯示安全訊息，並可再次嘗試
zh-TW.scenario: 模擬查詢拋出 ValueError，含測試字串「private question and token」；記錄錯誤訊號與套用結果。
actions: 執行失敗的查詢，等待結果傳遞完成。
用相同鍵值再次查詢，這次回傳 recovered。
expected_outcomes: 唯一錯誤訊息完全等於 'Saved analysis could not be checked; please retry'；失敗後不套用任何結果。
再次嘗試只套用 recovered。
zh-TW.risk_protected: 避免把私密例外文字顯示為狀態錯誤，並確保失敗後仍能重試。
not_proven: 私密文字是合成測試資料，未涵蓋真實供應商錯誤、實際憑證或全部錯誤畫面。
重試的是已存狀態查詢，不是付費 AI 分析。

en.title: Closing the status worker ignores its late result
en.scenario: A simulated worker is held after it starts; it would eventually return late.
actions: Start the check and wait for its entry signal.
Close LatestStatus before releasing the check.
Release and drain the work, then attempt a new check.
expected_outcomes: No late result is applied.
The closed worker refuses the new request.
en.risk_protected: Work finishing after its status consumer closes must not update that consumer or admit new work.
not_proven: The running function may finish; immediate thread termination is not proven.
This is the status worker close contract, not the whole MainWindow restart/update/close journey or live model cancellation.

zh-TW.title: 關閉狀態工作器後，不套用晚到的結果
zh-TW.scenario: 模擬背景工作開始後暫停；它稍後會回傳 late。
actions: 啟動查詢，等待工作確實進入執行。
先關閉 LatestStatus，再放行暫停的工作。
等待工作與結果傳遞完成，然後再嘗試送出查詢。
expected_outcomes: 不套用任何晚到結果。
已關閉的工作器拒絕新請求。
zh-TW.risk_protected: 避免狀態顯示端關閉後，晚到工作仍更新它或重新接收工作。
not_proven: 允許正在執行的函式完成，未證明能立即終止執行緒。
只涵蓋狀態工作器的關閉契約，不是整個 MainWindow 重啟、更新、關閉流程，也不是真實模型取消。

en.title: A held status result is discarded after the source or view changes
en.scenario: An actual AnalysisBar starts a held fake analyze.status call in each unbound/enrolled workspace. It would report all five status fields complete.
actions: Show paper and wait until the background status check has entered.
Change exactly one context: overwrite the PDF, change store.DB_PATH to other.sqlite, set the bar's paper_id to other, or close the bar.
Release the fake response and drain worker/Qt delivery.
expected_outcomes: The held status call receives verify_sources=True and runs off the main thread.
After every change, the bar state remains {}; the stale all-complete result is not applied.
en.risk_protected: Status for an old PDF, workspace, paper selection or closed bar must not appear as the current paper's completion.
not_proven: The workspace case changes the global path; it does not assert that other.sqlite is never opened or created.
It does not assert note/draft preservation, permanent data changes, live AI behavior, scientific correctness or the whole window lifecycle.

放行假的狀態回應，等待背景工作與 Qt 結果傳遞完成。
expected_outcomes: 暫停的查詢必須收到 verify_sources=True，且不在主執行緒執行。
每種改變後狀態列都維持 {}，不套用過期的全部完成結果。
zh-TW.risk_protected: 避免把舊 PDF、舊工作區、舊論文選取或已關閉狀態列的結果，顯示為目前論文的完成狀態。
not_proven: 工作區案例只改全域路徑，未斷言 other.sqlite 絕不被開啟或建立。
未斷言筆記／草稿保存、永久資料異動、真實 AI 行為、科學正確性或完整視窗生命週期。

actions: Restore independently with the old folder unavailable, adopt, repeat the native review entry, edit/save/read A, cancel then confirm Apply, continue typing and reopen.

en.risk_protected: Prevent lost recovered words, wrong originals, duplicate decisions and late replacement of accepted research.
